title: PM Mementos e-Auction brings Punjab’s Heritage, Bhangra and Diljit Dosanjh into Focus
subtitle: PM Mementos e-Auction offers an opportunity to bid on mementos reflecting Punjab’s faith, heritage and contemporary culture
body_text:
The many faces of Punjab, its faith, history, music, dance and living traditions, find expression in a distinctive collection of mementos featured in the PM Mementos e-Auction 2026. Miniature representations of the Golden Temple, portraits of Sikh spiritual figures, Bhangra and a glimpse into Diljit Dosanjh’s global musical journey bring together timeless heritage and contemporary cultural expression.
One memento of the Golden Temple is a detailed miniature model of Sri Harmandir Sahib, while another presents the shrine within a glass dome, creating a distinctive floating effect, both reflecting the architectural and spiritual significance of the iconic Amritsar landmark.
The collection also pays tribute to Guru Nanak Dev Ji through a silver-framed portrait presented by the Gurudwara Managing Committee, Gurubagh, and Varanasi. Another poignant artwork depicts Mata Gujri Ji with the young Sahibzadas, Zorawar Singh and Fateh Singh, recalling their place in Sikh history and the values of courage, sacrifice and faith associated with their story.
Punjab’s vibrant cultural identity comes alive through a painting of Bhangra, capturing the movement, colour and celebratory spirit of the traditional folk dance. The collection also takes a contemporary turn with a photoprint of Diljit Dosanjh’s Dil-Luminati Tour, representing the global reach of Punjabi music and popular culture.
Another notable entry is a framed portrait of Sant Shri Sevalal Maharaj, depicting the spiritual and social reformer in a blessing posture. Completing the collection are saffron Gurdwara headscarves with golden threadwork, traditionally associated with humility and reverence in Sikh places of worship.
Together, these mementos tell a story that moves from sacred spaces and spiritual traditions to folk culture and contemporary music, offering a glimpse into the diverse cultural expressions associated with Punjab.
The PM Mementos e-Auction give people an opportunity to place their bids. Proceeds from the auction will support the Namami Gange Mission. Visit pmmementos.gov.in to place your bid.
